## Change

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and the affected plan task ID.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and pass locally.
- [ ] No secret, credential, production identifier, or real candidate PII was added.
- [ ] Logs and errors do not expose transcript, resume, token, or provider data.
- [ ] Security and authorization behavior was tested where applicable.
- [ ] Schema/config changes include migration or rollback notes where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects current behavior and evidence date.

## Risk and recovery

Describe failure modes, monitoring, and the tested recovery or roll-forward path.
